a1
Joseph told his steward: fill their sacks, and put my silver cup in the youngest brother's sack.
a2
The steward overtook the brothers and accused them of stealing his master's cup.
b1
They said: whoever has it will die, and we will be slaves. The steward said: only he will be my slave.
b2
The cup was in Benjamin's sack. They tore their clothes and returned to the city.
c1
They fell before Joseph. Judah said: God has found our guilt. Joseph said: only the one with the cup will be my slave. The rest may go in peace.
c2
Judah stepped forward. He said their old father loved Benjamin, and would die of grief without him.
d1
Judah said: I promised my father I would bear the blame forever if I failed.
d2
Let me stay as your slave in his place. How can I return to my father without him?
h1
Judah offered his own freedom so Benjamin could go home.
h2
Love is more than a feeling. It pays what someone else would owe.
h3
We are rarely asked for freedom. We are often asked for time, comfort or pride.
h4
Today, carry a cost for someone you love.
i
What would you give up for your family?
